v31.pergunta: This is the 'objeto' (subject) of a Brazilian public procurement notice, written in Portuguese. Is the public body contracting or accrediting ('credenciamento') a bank or financial institution to RUN ITS PAYROLL — that is, to process, manage and pay the salary credits of its public servants ('processamento e gerenciamento de créditos provenientes da folha de pagamento', 'pagamento da folha', 'centralização da folha', 'cessão onerosa do direito de processar a folha')? Judge what is being CONTRACTED, not words that are merely mentioned.
v31.sim: yes: a bank or financial institution will process, manage or pay the payroll credits of the servants, is accredited to do so ('credenciamento'), or buys the exclusive right to do so — even when other banking services (tax collection, supplier payments, payroll loans offered as an extra) are bundled in
v31.nao: no: the contract is something else — a payroll loan product on its own (empréstimo consignado), payroll software or IT services, consulting or studies about the payroll, bank fees or file transfer services paid by the body, an institutional bank account, or unrelated goods/services
